item.title: [IGNITE-6671] [Web Console] Wrong java type used in generated config from DB schema
item.description:

item.summary: [Web Console] Wrong java type used in generated config from DB schema

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
Fixed data type selection to fit to maximal values of Oracle number columns.
Types to test: NUMBER, NUMBER(1), NUMBER(3), NUMBER(5), NUMBER(10), NUMBER(19), NUMBER(20)

Failed tested in branch:

  2. imported into project via web console

Looks good. Merged to master.
